description: Pass 3 expansion of wolfram-conus-textile-rule30: Ermentrout, Campbell & Oster (1986) / Boettiger, Ermentrout & Oster (2009) neurosecretory mantle-edge threshold automaton, Waddington & Cowe (1969) / Meinhardt (1995) multi-clade molluscan Wolfram Class II-IV benchmark (Oliva porphyria, Conus textile, Cymbiola innexa), and 2D chiral tent-wall & quadratic ANF carry observables that resolve the 1D chord-length indiscriminability gap.

ermentrout_oster_neural_mantle_spec.governing_equation: S_{t+1,i} = H( sum_{j} W_E(i-j) A_{t,j} - sum_{j} W_I(i-j) I_{t,j} - R_{t,i} - theta ),  R_{t+1,i} = g_R S_{t+1,i} + lambda_R R_{t,i}
ermentrout_oster_neural_mantle_spec.isomorphism_note: When left synaptic drive w_left = 2 and right/center excitation saturates at 1 via local lateral inhibition of (c & r), the net excitation E(l,c,r) = 2*l + (c | r) fires in the window [1, 2] and quenches at E = 3 (refractory overflow l=1, (c|r)=1), reproducing Rule 30 a_{t+1,i} = l XOR (c OR r) across all 8 binary 3-cell neighborhoods with 0 bit errors.
